title: Vesper and the Summit
author: C. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Marguerite Marchetti, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
